en.summary: This commit fixes an L1 DCache response-stage bug where read-hit and miss-return replies were not held across core-response queue backpressure, allowing replies to be overwritten or dropped.
why_it_counts: The commit message explicitly describes a core response queue overflow fix.
The substantive logic change is in the L1 DCache response datapath, not in tooling.
The patch adds ready-qualified holding for both hit-generated and miss-generated core responses.
disqualifiers: The patch also comments out one pipeline assertion and changes a test timeout, but those edits are ancillary.
evidence: readHit_st2 changes from RegNext(readHit_st1) to held state instead of a one-cycle pulse.
A new readHit_st2 && !coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready branch re-drives the cached read data while the response queue is stalled.
coreRsp_st2_valid_from_coreReq_Reg changes from RegNext(...) to RegEnable(..., coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready).
coreRsp_st2_valid_from_memRsp likewise changes from RegNext(...) to RegEnable(..., coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready).

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A pipelined cache often generates a core-visible response one stage before a downstream response FIFO or Decoupled interface accepts it. If the response-valid and response-data state advances unconditionally, backpressure causes a hit reply or miss return to be overwritten, replayed incorrectly, or dropped. The fix makes the response stage hold its state until enqueue is actually accepted.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A load hit or miss return reaches the response stage while the downstream core-response queue is not ready.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Allow the response stage valid/data markers to advance for only one cycle even when the downstream enqueue is stalled.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: remove ready gating from response hold registers and delete stall-time replay logic
portability_notes: Apply this to the stage that latches cache hit data or miss-return data before a FIFO, queue, or ready/valid boundary.
If the DUT has separate hit-generated and miss-generated valid bits, both should lose their downstream-ready qualification to match the original bug class.
The bug is about control-state retention under stall, not about SRAM read contents or request decode.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the register or small queue that stores a core response between cache lookup completion and response enqueue.
Replace a held or ready-gated response-valid register with an unconditional one-cycle pipeline register, or remove the ready term from its enable.
Remove the branch that reissues cached response data when the response queue remains full.
Keep the downstream response queue unchanged so only the response-retention behavior becomes faulty.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DataCache coreRsp_Q enqueue path around readHit_st2 and coreRsp_st2_valid_from_* tracking
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix turns readHit_st2 into held state, adds an explicit replay path when coreRsp_Q is not ready, and changes both core-request and miss-response valid tracking from unconditional RegNext to ready-gated RegEnable logic.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In commit 45e8e293/7dbd257b, readHit_st2 stops being RegNext(readHit_st1), a readHit_st2 && !coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready data branch is added, and response-valid registers become gated by coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Under response backpressure, load-hit or miss-return replies can be lost, delayed incorrectly, or mismatched to requests, potentially surfacing as queue overflow symptoms or missing core responses.
evidence_for_injection: The modified logic sits directly between cache-hit/miss-return generation and coreRsp_Q enqueue.
Both hit and miss response valid paths are changed to hold state until downstream ready.
The added stall branch only exists to preserve response data when enqueue cannot happen in the current cycle.
notes: The assertion comment-out and test timeout edit are not part of the reusable fault model.
Dataset items 81 and 82 are the same hardware fix on two branches.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 L1 DCache 响应级的一个错误：当核心响应队列回压时，read-hit 与 miss-return 回复没有被保持，导致回复可能被覆盖或丢失。
why_it_counts: 提交信息明确说明修复的是核心响应队列 overflow。
实质性修改位于 L1 DCache 的响应数据通路，而不是工具或测试基础设施。
补丁为 hit 产生的回复和 miss 产生的回复都加入了受 ready 约束的保持逻辑。
disqualifiers: 补丁还顺带注释掉一个流水线断言并修改了测试超时，但这些改动是附带噪声。
evidence: readHit_st2 从 RegNext(readHit_st1) 改成了可保持状态，而不是单周期脉冲。
新增的 readHit_st2 && !coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready 分支会在响应队列阻塞时重新驱动缓存的读数据。
coreRsp_st2_valid_from_coreReq_Reg 从 RegNext(...) 改为 RegEnable(..., coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready)。
coreRsp_st2_valid_from_memRsp 也从 RegNext(...) 改为 RegEnable(..., coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready)。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在带流水线的 cache 中，核心可见的回复通常会先在一个阶段生成，再进入下游的 FIFO 或 ready/valid 接口。如果回复的 valid 与 data 状态不管下游是否接收都继续前进，那么一旦出现回压，hit 回复或 miss 返回就会被覆盖、错误重放或直接丢失。本次修复的本质就是让响应级在真正入队之前一直保持状态。

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 当 load hit 或 miss return 到达响应级，而下游核心响应队列还没有 ready 时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让响应级的 valid/data 标记即使在下游入队被阻塞时也只保持一个周期后继续前进。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: remove ready gating from response hold registers and delete stall-time replay logic
portability_notes: 把这个故障映射到 cache lookup 完成后、进入 FIFO/队列/ready-valid 边界之前的回复保持级。
如果目标 DUT 分开保存 hit 回复 valid 和 miss 回复 valid，应同时去掉这两条路径上的下游 ready 约束。
这个 bug 的核心是阻塞条件下的控制状态保持错误，而不是 SRAM 数据内容本身。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到在 cache 命中或 miss 返回之后、正式送入核心回复接口之前保存回复的寄存器或小队列。
把受 ready 控制的回复 valid 保持寄存器改成无条件单周期流水寄存器，或者删掉其使能条件中的 ready。
删除在响应队列满时重放缓存回复数据的分支。
保持下游回复队列本身不变，只让回复保持行为出错。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DataCache 中围绕 readHit_st2 与 coreRsp_st2_valid_from_* 的 coreRsp_Q 入队路径
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 readHit_st2 改成可保持状态，在 coreRsp_Q 未 ready 时加入显式重放分支，并把 coreReq 与 missRsp 的 valid 跟踪从无条件 RegNext 改成受 ready 控制的 RegEnable。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在提交 45e8e293/7dbd257b 中，readHit_st2 不再是 RegNext(readHit_st1)，新增了 readHit_st2 && !coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready 分支，多个 response-valid 寄存器也改为由 coreRsp_Q.io.enq.ready 门控。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当响应路径出现回压时，load-hit 或 miss-return 回复可能丢失、错误延迟，或与请求错配，表现为 overflow、超时或缺失的核心回复。
evidence_for_injection: 修改后的逻辑正好位于 cache 命中或 miss 返回生成之后、coreRsp_Q 入队之前。
命中回复和 miss 回复两条 valid 路径都被改成了等到下游 ready 才前进。
新增的阻塞分支唯一目的就是在无法入队时保留回复数据。
notes: 被注释掉的断言和测试超时调整不属于可复用的故障模型。
数据集条目 81 和 82 对应的是两个分支上的同一硬件修复。
